metadata.description: Riley's coding and engineering skills: first-party Code/Cowork handoff, plus vendored collections for TDD, debugging, planning, code review, MCP building, frontend/webapp tooling, and filtering generic AI output.

plugins.name: riley-coding-skills
plugins.description: Riley's own coding skills: code-cowork-handoff, which spots when work belongs in Claude Code vs Cowork and writes a paste-ready handoff file for the other side.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Jesse Vincent's superpowers (MIT): a coding-agent methodology in 14 skills — TDD, systematic debugging, planning, code review, git worktrees. Named 'superpowers' so the skills' internal cross-references resolve.

plugins.name: anthropic-coding-skills
plugins.description: Engineering example skills from anthropics/skills (Apache 2.0): mcp-builder, webapp-testing, web-artifacts-builder, frontend-design, claude-api.

plugins.name: antislop
plugins.description: Miqdad Badjuber's anti-slop (MIT): a filter that stops AI coding agents from shipping generic UI, copy, and code comments, in 6 skills plus a mandatory delivery gate.
